title: Barrelhouse names from the interviewer's list: Clayton, Dookie, Honey
summary: The interviewer reads names of piano players; Williams knows only Clayton (piano and trumpet) and says others came after he left. He recalls Honey and Little Willie.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: I got a list of the Barrow House piano players in New Orleans. Let me pick some out. Did you ever hear the name Papa Lord God? I have heard of, but I don't know. I couldn't tell you nothing about it. Regging Willie Welf. No, I don't know. Ford. Just Ford. Did Clayton?
Yeah, not as piano player. Piano player, little Clayton.

Played both, I know. Yeah. Clayton, he played piano and trumpet too. I think Clayton lived. No, he died recently. Did he? Yeah. He wasn't living. Sure, I know. Little Dookie. Dookie. Dookie. Dookie. What is that? Piano player? Yeah. That's how I made. Little Willie. I know Little Willie. Little Dookie. Or Little Sammy. I'll call him in a minute. I'll call him in a minute. Them guy must have come up for after I left there. Them guy had come up after I left there. See, I left them all through the other day. Send me up, can you? I know that guy. I know that guy. I might have, but I can't recall.
Yes, of course. What so long ago?

Long ago. I might have, but I can't recall. You just think like Steve Lewis, I know them guys. I'd be around them, Steve Lewis, Hugh Dale Wilson, and Ray Caillou, Little Honey. Honey. Another piano player, they played around all. Honey? Honey. Yeah, they called him Honey. I didn't know his last name. He played too.
